evidenceNotes: Pinned BWAPI4.4.0/OpenBW data reproduces exactly: Infestation builtin0energy,completed ground Terran CC below50percent visible HP;749of1500 succeeds,750 fails. Authored1tile inclusive body contact range,instant conversion,no approach/3frame delay/60frame Queen hiding or extra cooldown. These timing differences are explicit in the design document.

Same entity ID/location/footprint becomes a Zerg Infested CC owned by the Queen,restored to1500HP. Old paid queues/research return fully to the original payer; this refund differs intentionally from OpenBW owner-change/cancel ordering. Repeat/rally,worker home,old groups/addons/ownership references and supply reservations are cleaned. No headquarters/resource-return/supply/normal-construction function; no lift/creep spread in the current engine.

Infested Terran production costs100minerals50gas,250ticks,2supply halves,without larva.60HP,original5.82speed,ground transport1slot,researched burrow and organic healing work through existing systems. Automatic3px ground melee and manual current-position suicide deal500Explosive raw damage with body-distance20/40/60px full/half/quarter bands. Armor,shields,size scaling and friendly ground/building damage apply. Air,cargo,Stasis,unstarted structures are excluded; burrowed victims only take inner-band damage. Ordinary death does not explode; simultaneous suicide attacks both resolve. One-tick manual requests lock later actor orders and cannot survive into a valid save.

Separate Zerg-vs-Terran infestation practice provides one Queen,a damaged600HP extra CC and explicit500mineral200gas practice grant; the enemy original HQ remains so production/combat can continue. Saves use infestation.zerg independently of special/economy keys. Existing saves receive no practice units/resources/energy. Current last-headquarters capture triggers the existing headquarters victory rule.

Both portrait sizes locally and on production use actual Worker/Pixi/native touch: out-of-range rejection,movement into contact,builtin zero-cost capture,same-ID ownership/1500HP,exact capture and paid pending-production reload,automatic enemy suicide,second paid manual suicide with friendly CC damage,post-blast save continuity and landscape pause. No game-state/resource/energy injection or clock acceleration.

Twenty-four untouched production saves from formats12..24 restore at exact ticks locally and publicly,including active Broodlings lifetimes,Parasite/shared vision,Ensnare,Medic spells,Stim,energy,cargo,cloak,siege,morphs,pending orders/production/research,groups,resources and RNG. Original raw backups remain byte-for-byte; format24 uses stage6o-backup.

Early automation used a nearby Queen hit instead of a ground move,looked for the producer helper with no selected entity,and tapped a paused overlay at360px. The harness now moves through clear ground,resumes before canvas reselection,and uses native actionability scrolling. Earlier attempts are preserved separately and excluded from final passing counts. Initial legacy protocol tests incorrectly treated a Zerg-only mode as available to every race; the enabled combination is tested and matches the lobby restriction.

GitHub main advanced concurrently to3fa37e21 during publication. All11 Haerujilot/StarDraft source/docs/tests changes and signed ancestry are preserved in a true merge with the Infestation feature. No Stark Rift implementation file changed during integration. The final clean-source CI passes npm ci,full npm test(689game,264shared,61Haeru,28Baksal),lab build and benchmark. Final main,Sites source,clean build,saved version/deployment and artifact file hashes agree.

The first lossless gzip artifact exceeded32MiB. Compression was refined without deleting or altering any artifact asset. Every tar file is individually SHA256 compared with the clean canonical build. Source and QA ZIPs are CRC/SHA256 checked and their hashes are retained in this external receipt and remote verification branch.

The first production attempt reported a bootstrap module fetch failure and a renderer that was not ready. The public bootstrap subsequently returned200 and matched the exact canonical bytes. Fresh full replays with request-failure tracing passed without reproducing the asset error; the initial reports remain under initial-attempts. No application state or asset was altered to bypass the failed load.

Chromium SwiftShader/native touch does not certify physical Android/iOS or hardware GPU. Queen spell/autocast policy,original approach/cast animations,strategic AI,other technologies and final graphics remain subsequent work.
